name: Emia
source:
Race: Female human
Origin: White Mountain
Hobby: Experimenting
Job: Professor

A young professor who specialized in studying Crystal Monsters. In OASE, Emia can be found in Cloud City's Study Room, studying Cloud City and its inhabitants.

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
